# Theme

> UI design tokens (colour, font, spacing, radius).

- Package: `Theme` · Category: Shared utilities
- Starts at server boot: only when picked; otherwise the first time game code uses it
- Installing it also installs: nothing else (only Core)
- Check it is installed: `GaxiaServer.IsInstalled("Theme")` on the server; `Gaxia.IsInstalled("Theme")` on the client

## `Gaxia.Theme`

- Runs: **server and client**
- Source: `src/ReplicatedStorage/Gaxia_Packages/Shared/Theme.lua`

Get it:

```lua
local Gaxia = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages)
local Theme = Gaxia.Theme
-- or, to get its types in your own ModuleScript: local Theme = require(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage").Gaxia_Packages.Shared.Theme)
```

### Functions

- `Theme.Get(): Tokens`
- `Theme.Color(name: ColorName | string): Color3`
  Unknown names return white.
- `Theme.Spacing(name: SpacingName | string): number`
  Unknown names return 0.
- `Theme.Radius(name: RadiusName | string): number`
  Unknown names return 0.
- `Theme.SetTheme(partial: { [string]: { [string]: any } }): ()`
  Shallow-merge a partial override per category (Color/Font/Spacing/Radius) and notify listeners. Only the keys you pass change.
- `Theme.OnThemeChanged(fn: (tokens: Tokens) -> ()): () -> ()`
  Returns an unsubscribe function.
